title: Watching Over Our Community of Shared Destiny
text: “Can you really say that what you’re saying is right and just?”
“What do you mean?”
“As you can see, the Second Princess is alive and unharmed.”
My father is standing there with his shield raised, as if determined to protect his Finacée at all costs. He looks incredibly reliable.

“Spear Hero. The Shield Hero is innocent. In fact, he’s the one protecting my life. Besides, you’ve told me the name of one of the owners of the feathers you entrusted to me. You were trying to tell me about Filo-chan, weren’t you?”
“Oink?”
The Crimson Swine is looking at me. Ugh… Does the feather I gave her to cheer up my Finacée have something to do with this?
“Ah, yeah. I heard she likes Filolial, so… I gave her the feather I found that belonged to Filo-chan.”
I’ve got to bluff my way out of this. My father shot me a piercing glance. This is just a guess, but there’s no doubt he thinks of me as a man who wouldn’t lay a finger on a woman.
“Please believe me. There’s a massive conspiracy behind this whole commotion.”
“But Princess Melty is being paraded around by that man, isn’t she!”
Smoked Meat, you really need to cut it out. Just how much longer do you plan to parrot Itsuki’s lines before you’re satisfied?
“That’s exactly why I’m asking him—to protect my life.”
“Nonsense…”
Still, his reaction here is definitely different from Itsuki’s.
“Doesn’t that seem unnatural? What would the Shield Hero stand to gain by kidnapping me?”
“She’s just the young Second Princess… She’s being deceived by the Shield Demon.”
Smoked Meat’s reaction is far more malicious. You can tell even from a distance that his heart is rotten.
“Spear Hero, didn’t you think it was strange that the Kingdom of Melromarc treated only the Shield Hero differently?”
“That’s true.”
He nods honestly because he knows it’s true. At this level… it should be fine; it shouldn’t significantly shake the bigger picture.

“My mother said it herself: now is the time for people to join hands and stand united to ward off disaster… This world cannot afford to let you Heroes waste time on such unnecessary matters. I implore you all—please sheathe your weapons, just as the Spear Hero has done.”
Well, since I’d been acting like I wanted to talk from the start, my Finacée told me to address everyone.
“Got it? This is a conspiracy. I’m going to tell you everything I know about what’s really going on. Motoyasu, we can decide whether to fight or not after that, right?”
As for reconciliation at this point… I know it’s possible if I use my power, but that’s not an option.
“Bubuhi-bubububububu!”
The Crimson Swine started talking on its own, so I’ll just go with the flow.
“Bububu-hi! Bububu! Buhi-buhi!”
Given the situation and context, it’s probably referring to brainwashing. I can tell because its already ugly face is getting even uglier.
“Big Sis!?”

The power of brainwashing did exist, after all. It was certainly a real phenomenon—a creation researched by the Three Heroes Church. It was simply exploited for Itsuki’s benefit. In fact, it’s precisely because we know such power exists that this outlandish story seems credible.
“You mean the ‘Shield of Brainwashing’—that shield imbued with an evil power? I was skeptical, but…”
It’s unclear who said this, but I’ll go along with it.
“Oink-oink-oink! Oink! ”
Well, I have absolutely no idea what he’s saying. Crimson Swine is desperately spreading his arms wide to explain to me, but I can tell at a glance that he’s just jumping on the bandwagon with lies.
“From what I’ve heard, Oto—Naofumi—seems to have been traveling all over the place, cleaning up the messes that I, Itsuki, and Ren caused…”
I’ll counter Crimson Swine based on what I’ve found out so far. Then I noticed Crimson Swine let out a soft click of his tongue. The old me would’ve just let that slide.
“Bub! Buhiihi! Bubuuu… Buhi”
The conversation has completely shifted, and I have no idea what he’s saying now. The Crimson Swine clung to me as if appealing to my emotions, pointing at my Father and my Finacée.
“Spear Hero! You must not believe what my older sister says!”

Finacée! Forget about believing her—I don’t even have the slightest clue what she’s talking about! Ugh… I really wish someone would decode this pig language for me! At times like this, I can’t help but feel so grateful to my Father, Yuki-chan, and the other Filolial-sama who taught me. Or even my Big Sister—please, just tell me. What did this pig just say?

I’ll just have to answer based on a hunch. It’s precisely because I’ve been siding too much with my Father that the Crimson Swine unexpectedly clung to me. In other words, I just need to answer in a way that’s inconvenient for my Father.
“That might actually be possible.”
“Motoyasu… you lecherous bastard…”
My father muttered under his breath with a look of loathing. Ugh… I certainly was like that back in the day. But that’s not the case anymore.

If anything, Father. No, if I’d managed to win over the father who’d already devoted himself to my Rival back then, perhaps I wouldn’t have had any regrets afterward. So, should I go after my father? It feels like both the father from the original world and the father who gave himself to Rival are waving their hands in unison, saying, “No way,” but that’s just how much I care about him!
“Ooogggh! Ooh-hee-hee! Ooogggg—……”
Right after the Crimson Swine finished his long, rambling speech, Father spoke up loudly.
“Do you even have that kind of power, you idiot!”
Well, I do have it.
“Does the Shield Hero have that kind of power?”

At least my Father certainly doesn’t. The frustration of not being able to say that… I’ll just have to be patient. I’ll hold on a little longer, until the Crimson Swine and that Trash lose their power.
“Does it look like I have it?”
“Hmm… I don’t think so.”
“I wanted an immediate answer on that.”
My Finacée’s reaction seems a bit childish, doesn’t it? As I watched in silence, thinking that, my Father spoke up.
“Depending on how things go, I might even hand the Second Princess over to you two.”
“Huh!?”
This is definitely a bad move. However… well, with my abilities, it wouldn’t be too hard to protect my Finacée from Crimson Swine’s clutches if I really wanted to.
“Hmph… Let’s hear what you have to say.”
Smoked Meat, is it about time I ripped your mouth open? You’d better understand your place! And cut the hero act already.
“First of all, there’s no such thing as the power of brainwashing. Starting from there—”
“This is pointless!”
“Shut up! I’m not talking to you! Damn it! Are Ren and Itsuki not here?!”
“I’m not here because of some errand.”
“Or rather, you guys… you didn’t kill Ren and Itsuki just because they were useless, did you?”
Whoa! Father, are you throwing down a counterattack right here? Just as I’d expect from you, Father.
“How rude! It’s just that Lord Itsuki doesn’t even need to show up for someone like you!”
“Bububu!”
Crimson Swine and Smoked Meat are making a racket together. They really hit it off—a perfect match. Should we just get rid of them all at once?
“…These guys aren’t exactly the kind you can trust.”
My father-in-law looked at Smoked Meat, Crimson Swine, and me, nodding repeatedly.
“Filo, I know you don’t want to, but abandon the cart and run away from these guys!”
“Okay!”
My father-in-law and the others climbed onto Filo-tan’s back—dressed as the Filolial Queen—and took off running.
“See ya.”
“Ah, wait a minute!”
My father and the others raced off on Filo-tan’s back as fast as they could. I’m going after them!
“Ah, the Spear Guy.”
“Ugh! That Motoyasu guy is insanely fast!”
I’m going to follow my fathers-in-law as they run away.
“Spear Guy, don’t follow us!”
Filo-tan whips around in an instant, ready to deliver a kick. That sight overlapped with a certain memory.
“Hii, Hiiiiiiiiii!?”
I dodge Filo-tan’s kick by the skin of my teeth. But I ended up landing on my butt.
“Bye-bye, Spear Guy.”
“Ah, please wait for me!”
I reach out my hand, but Filo-tan has already sped off with my Father and the others on her back.
“Bububuhii!”
The Crimson Swine came chasing after me. It’s too late now. In any case, I’ve made contact. However… either way, I have to make sure my Father doesn’t cross the northeastern border.
And so, the chase between me and my Father and his men continued. Actually, even though I sensed they were hiding nearby, I pretended not to notice and kept chasing after them. But…
It’s really annoying that I can somehow tell Big Sister is watching me from afar with a furrowed brow. She’s quite perceptive. Before long, night fell.

Once night falls, the Crimson Swine tend to rest at nearby inns, so the search is bound to be suspended for the time being. So, taking advantage of this opportunity, I used my Cloaking Lance in combination with concealment Magic to check on my Father and the others. If I followed their scent, it wouldn’t take long.
After picking up the scents of Filo-tan, my Father, and Big Sister, I decided to quietly keep watch. It seems my Father is hiding by a campfire, having a discussion.
“It’s going to be pretty tough, but I think our only option is to break through in one go.”
Even for my Father, I don’t think it’ll be easy with his current strength.
“I suppose so… Rather than just keep running away like this—”
“Yeah…”
“Mel-chan!”

Just as he said that, a blow dart flew toward my Father and the others. Filo-tan transformed into her Filolial Queen form and wrapped herself around her Finacée to protect him. It’s dangerous! On the spot, she deflects the blowdart, sending it off course.
“What the—!?”
“My Lord! Something’s nearby!? It’s not this one!”
“What!?”
“There are tons of them a little further away. I didn’t notice them until they got close.”
Darts rained down from all around us. Oh well. I’ll try not to make a sound as I unleash a Windmill. A tornado swirled up, blowing away the lurkers without hitting my Father and the others.
“Oh, there’s one over here too!”
A pig came out to protect my Finacée. I thought about taking it out while I was at it, but since my Finacée seemed to be looking at that pig with relief, I’ll hold off for now.
“Oink, oink, oink!”
It seems there are still assassins lurking among the crowd. I’ll leap high into the air in one go and pinpoint the ones hiding nearby. As long as I’m in the air, I should be fine.
“Aiming Lancer X!”
I swept away the guys lurking all around me with a hail of Aiming Lancers. Well, I’ve secured the safety of my future Father.
“What’s this…?”

My Father and the others are looking around nervously. I guess I can’t hide it forever. I might have managed this without revealing myself, but I suppose I did it just to be on the safe side. With a flash, I canceled my stealth and revealed myself.
“You’re—!”
Father’s guard went up instantly. How can I get him to trust me?
“I mean no harm.”
I raised both hands to show I had no hostile intentions.
“How can I believe that?!”

The Father’s wariness is exceptionally strong. How can I get him to trust me? Would he believe me if I explained things the way I did when the loop first started? No, if I explain too much, I won’t be able to steer things toward the outcome I’m aiming for… Ugh, this is incredibly frustrating.
“I really haven’t set anything up, you know? After all, I’ve just wiped out the enemies right here.”
“I don’t know about that…”
“Bubub!”
That pig acting all cozy with my Finacée is saying something.
“Well… it certainly seems there’s no doubt that the Spear Hero wiped out the kingdom’s assassination squad.”
“Naofumi-sama, I’m just guessing, but doesn’t the Spear Hero also realize something’s off about this incident?”
Big Sister came to my rescue right then.
“Raphtalia? What are you talking about, too?”
My Father replied to Big Sister with a look of disbelief.
“Actually… during the chase earlier today, the Spear Hero’s gaze moved in a way that made it seem like he knew where we were hiding…”
“Come to think of it, she did mention that. Motoyasu, is that true?”
“You have a good intuition.”

Big Sister’s intuition is on par with Father’s. It’s also true that a tragedy occurred in the past because of that. I have bitter memories of how her keen intuition led to Father finding out I was helping him.
“Hmm?”
Eek!? Filo-tan! Please stop making that kicking pose at me!
“…You—are you joking with that tone?”
“I’m not joking.”
“You’ve been acting strange ever since that wave the other day, haven’t you? It’s like you’re deliberately making the wrong choices…”
Gulp… I take my hat off to Big Sister’s keen intuition.
Sword… 20%  Bow… 44%
